verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer offers client-facing software (GDHQ, the Contract Generator, the D&O portal and Catalyze), so agent API access is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence documents any API, credential issuance or scoped/least-privilege tokens. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
